definitions.explanation: Describes something so large, extreme, or far-reaching that it is beyond normal scale or expectation.
Describes something so unreasonable or ridiculous that it defies common sense.

examples.japanese: {途方|とほう}もない⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧だ。
examples.english: It's an enormous amount of money.

examples.japanese: {途方|とほう}もなく⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{砂漠|さばく}→砂漠：09508_sabaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いていた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: An immensely vast desert stretched on.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{途方|とほう}もない⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧だろう。
examples.english: It will probably take an enormous amount of time to realize this plan.

examples.japanese: {途方|とほう}もない⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{途方|とほう}もないこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}い{出|だ}した→言い出す：04593_iidasu⟧。
examples.english: He came out with something outrageous.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧{途方|とほう}もない⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れられない→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧。
examples.english: Such an outrageous demand cannot be accepted.

notes:
Describes something so extreme in scale or so unreasonable that it defies normal expectations.

FORMS:
- {途方|とほう}もない + noun: {途方|とほう}もない⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧ (an enormous sum)
- {途方|とほう}もなく + adjective/verb: {途方|とほう}もなく⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (immensely vast)

USAGE:
Sense 1 (enormous) is more common than sense 2 (absurd). The adverbial form {途方|とほう}もなく is especially frequent.

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{途方|とほう}に{暮|く}れる→途方に暮れる：17548_tohounikureru⟧ means "to be at a loss" or "to be bewildered." It shares the ⟦{途方|とほう}→途方：09447_tohou⟧ element but has a completely different meaning — ⟦{途方|とほう}→途方：09447_tohou⟧ here means "way/method," so "to have no way forward."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とんでもない→とんでもない：03470_tondemonai⟧: outrageous, unthinkable (stronger surprise/disbelief)
- ⟦{莫大|ばくだい}→莫大：03700_bakudai⟧な: enormous (used specifically for quantities/amounts)
